text: INTERPRETER Env factory: Env's constructors become private to interp/env.rs and every Env of a run is made by the Interp (new_env, env_from_snapshot, the frame pool moved into env.rs), which gives it a taint store exactly when seal.active; a given frame is emptied (taints with bindings), a snapshot whose store does not match the run panics, and a taint read from a store-less Env panics (never reads 0). Unsealed runs: same envs, no store, behaviour unchanged; not PCI-reviewed; every sealed run is still refused (SEAL_RUNTIME_COMPLETE = false)
